sql:
SELECT
  severity,
  count(*) AS total_events,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved) AS resolved_count,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT resolved) AS unresolved_count,
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS pct_resolved,
  round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (resolved_at - occurred_at)) / 86400.0) FILTER (WHERE resolved), 1) AS avg_days_to_resolve,
  round(
    (percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (resolved_at - occurred_at)) / 86400.0) FILTER (WHERE resolved))::numeric,
    1
  ) AS median_days_to_resolve,
  round(
    max(CASE WHEN NOT resolved THEN extract(epoch FROM (timestamp '2025-12-31' - occurred_at)) / 86400.0 END)::numeric,
    0
  ) AS oldest_unresolved_age_days,
  count(DISTINCT event_type) AS distinct_event_types
FROM compliance_events
WHERE occurred_at >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
  AND occurred_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY total_events DESC, severity
